note: THE TAP CARD: one record, three surfaces. card.html renders from this file, tools/vcard.mjs derives mccluster.vcf from it, and the QR in assets/nfc/ points at the page. Edit here and re-run `node tools/vcard.mjs`; nothing about the card is typed twice.

person.title: Creative Director & Founder
person.photoNote: Drop a headshot at assets/img/card-portrait.jpg and put that path here. Left empty on purpose: the house mark stands in rather than using a frame from a night shoot as a business-card face.

reach.label: Call
reach.hint: Left blank on purpose: no phone number appears anywhere in this repo, so nothing was invented. Fill in value and href (tel:+15551234567) and both the card and the vCard pick it up.

reach.label: Text
reach.hint: Same number as above, as sms:+15551234567.

swap.lede: Now you. Leave yours and it lands on my desk, not in a pile of paper.
